name: After Hours #10 — Empty High Score
description: The high scores are still glowing for nobody. Coins sleep in the slots. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 10 is unlimited: anyone can mint this still. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever.
